    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.exists_surjective_ground_coefficients (k : Type u_1) (F : Type u_2) [Field k] [Infinite k] [Field F] [Algebra k F] {ι : Type u_3} {V : Type u_4} {W : Type u_5} [Fintype ι] [AddCommGroup V] [Module F V] [AddCommGroup W] [Module F W] [Module.Finite F W] (D : ι → V →ₗ[F] W) (a : ι → F) (ha : Function.Surjective ⇑(∑ i : ι, a i • D i)) :
    ∃ (c : ι → k), Function.Surjective ⇑(∑ i : ι, (algebraMap k F) (c i) • D i)

    If a linear family contains a surjection over an extension field, its coefficients may be chosen in any infinite ground field.
